generalized_learning.detection_rule: The independent auditor must run a cheap certificate/readiness preflight before broad discovery and reject a missing, stale, identity-mismatched or incomplete evidence packet.
generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can appear healthy from build, tests and happy-path evidence while its handoff omits deterministic proof that the canonical contract is fully covered and every material risk family and inherited control has already been exercised.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Declare a candidate ready after successful execution gates but do not certify canonical source coverage, requirement attacks, risk saturation, cumulative inherited controls and prior escape closure against the frozen material candidate.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The delivery controller must fail closed before handoff unless all canonical obligations are represented and every applicable material risk family plus inherited control is passed for the frozen material candidate.

reusable_control.procedure: Before independent audit expenditure, require a tamper-evident readiness certificate over complete canonical specification coverage, requirement attacks, risk saturation, cumulative inherited controls, escape closure and generalized learning; reject missing or stale evidence before broad audit.
